issue 1	retained-artifacts-accounted	Every retained artifact is addressable with explicit kind, provenance gaps and claim tier.	Discovery silently misses a file, merges overwrite chronology, or an override conceals missing references.
issue 1	historical-claims-scoped	Historical comparisons expose selection, reference and metric/timing limits beside results.	A generator averages unequal rows or labels a present-day source as the historical source.
issue 2	references-independent	New task truth is established from qualified sources without evaluated-output leakage.	Reference builder reads parser outputs, a PDF rendition disagrees, or metadata is assumed correct without inspection.
issue 2	reference-generation-preserves	Failed qualification or generation preserves existing valid references and inputs.	Conversion writes over an original PDF or validation occurs after replacing the completed bundle.
issue 3	task-checks-association	Task scoring rejects wrong field/record associations without rejecting declared harmless representation changes.	A value-token check passes transposed headers or normalization equates different amounts.
issue 3	extractor-blind	Expected answers cannot affect extracted predictions.	Extractor reads source metadata or uses grader truth as a parsing hint.
issue 4	execution-not-silent-replay	Fresh work cannot silently read unrelated cached/checkpoint output.	Cache ignores a backend option/version or a checkpoint accepts changed input/reference bytes.
issue 4	failures-visible	Every planned pair has inspectable terminal or incomplete status, with empty output distinct from failure and unavailable timing distinct from zero.	Exception paths omit records, timeout is inferred only from arbitrary error text, or empty output is counted as task success.
issue 4	bundle-atomic	A failed generation cannot replace a previously valid completed bundle or register an incomplete one as complete.	Registry switches before all artifacts validate or a partial file replaces its previous version.
issue 5	invoice-results-reproducible	Reported task/coverage aggregates and per-attempt duration observations reproduce from the actual run artifacts under declared boundaries.	Failed calls disappear, regrading reads new references, timing is cache replay, or relocated replay uses a different backend.
issue 6	report-inspectable	An engineer can inspect and reproduce each declared result and understand the decision it informs.	Numbers lack matching pointers/denominators, instructions fail offline, or failures are visible only in hidden artifacts.
issue 6	design-lessons-demonstrated	The worked example explains internal-benchmark design through actual decisions and counterexamples.	The report offers only limitation prose, presents a template as validated on real vendors, or invents an operational result.
